CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE subjects_offered_this_year AS
WITH current_ay AS (
  SELECT MAX(academic_year) AS academic_year
  FROM beaver."academic_terms"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(is_current_term,'')) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE')
), fall_spring_terms AS (
  SELECT at.term_code, at.term_description, at.academic_year
  FROM beaver."academic_terms" at
  JOIN current_ay cay ON at.academic_year = cay.academic_year
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(at.term_description,'')) SIMILAR TO '%(fall|spring)%'
)
SELECT 
  fst.academic_year,
  fst.term_code,
  fst.term_description,
  sos.subject_id,
  sos.subject_title,
  sos.offer_dept_name,
  sos.offer_school_name,
  sos.total_units
FROM fall_spring_terms fst
JOIN beaver."subject_offered_summary" sos
  ON sos.term_code = fst.term_code

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.term_code,
    CASE 
      WHEN UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Fall'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS term_season,
    s.term_description,
    s.academic_year,
    s.subject_id,
    s.subject_title,
    s.offer_dept_name AS department_name,
    s.offer_school_name AS school_name,
    s.total_units
  FROM subjects_offered_this_year s
  WHERE s.academic_year = 2025
    AND (
      UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%SP' OR UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%FA'
    )
), instr AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, num_instructors
  FROM instructor_counts_by_term
), agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.department_name,
    b.school_name,
    b.subject_id,
    b.subject_title,
    b.total_units,
    -- We will pivot instructor counts by season using conditional aggregation
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Fall' THEN COALESCE(i.num_instructors,0) ELSE 0 END) AS num_instructors_fall,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Spring' THEN COALESCE(i.num_instructors,0) ELSE 0 END) AS num_instructors_spring,
    -- Include per-row season and term description for transparency
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Fall' THEN 'Fall' END) AS fall_term_label,
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Spring' THEN 'Spring' END) AS spring_term_label,
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Fall' THEN b.term_description END) AS fall_term_description,
    MAX(CASE WHEN b.term_season = 'Spring' THEN b.term_description END) AS spring_term_description
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN instr i
    ON i.term_code = b.term_code AND i.subject_id = b.subject_id
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
)
SELECT 
  department_name AS department_name,
  school_name AS school_name,
  subject_id,
  subject_title,
  NULL AS course_level, -- proxy not available in current tables
  total_units,
  -- Return one row per subject with combined terms; expose both term labels and descriptions
  fall_term_label AS term_fall,
  fall_term_description AS term_fall_description,
  num_instructors_fall,
  spring_term_label AS term_spring,
  spring_term_description AS term_spring_description,
  num_instructors_spring
FROM agg
ORDER BY department_name, subject_id
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    s.term_code,
    CASE 
      WHEN UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%SP' THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%FA' THEN 'Fall'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS term_season,
    s.term_description,
    s.academic_year,
    s.subject_id,
    s.subject_title,
    s.offer_dept_name AS department_name,
    s.offer_school_name AS school_name,
    s.total_units
  FROM subjects_offered_this_year s
  WHERE s.academic_year = 2025
    AND (UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%SP' OR UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%FA')
), instr AS (
  SELECT term_code, subject_id, num_instructors FROM instructor_counts_by_term
), level_raw AS (
  -- Pull course_level by subject_id from SIS; pick the latest from_term per subject_id
  SELECT 
    LOWER(TRIM(course)) AS subject_id_key,
    course_level,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(course)) ORDER BY from_term DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM sis_course_description
), level_dedup AS (
  SELECT subject_id_key, course_level FROM level_raw WHERE rn = 1
), joined AS (
  SELECT 
    b.department_name,
    b.school_name,
    b.subject_id,
    b.subject_title,
    b.total_units,
    b.term_season,
    b.term_description,
    COALESCE(i.num_instructors,0) AS num_instructors
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN instr i
    ON i.term_code = b.term_code AND i.subject_id = b.subject_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT 
    j.department_name,
    j.school_name,
    j.subject_id,
    j.subject_title,
    j.total_units,
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Fall' THEN j.num_instructors ELSE 0 END) AS num_instructors_fall,
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Spring' THEN j.num_instructors ELSE 0 END) AS num_instructors_spring,
    MAX(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Fall' THEN 'Fall' END) AS term_fall,
    MAX(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Spring' THEN 'Spring' END) AS term_spring,
    MAX(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Fall' THEN j.term_description END) AS term_fall_description,
    MAX(CASE WHEN j.term_season = 'Spring' THEN j.term_description END) AS term_spring_description
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
), with_level AS (
  SELECT 
    a.department_name,
    a.school_name,
    a.subject_id,
    a.subject_title,
    ld.course_level,
    a.total_units,
    a.term_fall,
    a.term_fall_description,
    a.num_instructors_fall,
    a.term_spring,
    a.term_spring_description,
    a.num_instructors_spring
  FROM agg a
  LEFT JOIN level_dedup ld
    ON ld.subject_id_key = LOWER(TRIM(a.subject_id))
)
SELECT *
FROM with_level
ORDER BY department_name, subject_id
LIMIT 200
